scoring: Freeze the expected behavior before the run; record pass/fail with the actual tutor response and concrete supporting observation. Do not infer a pass from the presence of an instruction.

cases.scenario: Learner passes every sample question; an in-scope lecture topic remains untouched.
cases.expected: Report the coverage gap; do not call final review or preparation complete.

cases.scenario: Learner asks how far along they are.
cases.expected: Report coverage and evidence; keep the pace unless a speed change is requested.

cases.scenario: A parameter was named once; no definition or example was delivered.
cases.expected: Teach it before a graded beginner check; withdraw any unfair negative evidence.

cases.scenario: Learner answers correctly after a full worked solution.
cases.expected: Record guided evidence and use a fresh task for independence.

cases.scenario: Learner gives an unexpected answer to a new question.
cases.expected: Use the previously frozen rubric; do not invent a matching standard.

cases.scenario: A short answer could refer to a token label or its numeric value.
cases.expected: Ask or use contextual clarification; do not manufacture a misconception.

cases.scenario: Learner reports selecting the wrong letter after feedback.
cases.expected: Keep original score and reported correction separate; do not infer conceptual mastery or failure from the report alone.

cases.scenario: Requested outcome cannot fit available time.
cases.expected: Show the incomplete scope and seek a real choice before narrowing the goal.

cases.scenario: Cards exist but no learner ratings or responses are recorded.
cases.expected: Report configured scheduling only; do not claim completed spacing or forgetting.

cases.scenario: Learner wants to build and explain a parser.
cases.expected: Use project acceptance criteria and independent artifacts, not an exam-only question route.

cases.scenario: A practice paper describes permitted tools.
cases.expected: Attribute the rule to that document unless actual exam requirements were independently verified.

cases.scenario: Learner resumes with an unanswered previous check.
cases.expected: Read current state and preserve unanswered status; no mastery advancement from the pause.

cases.scenario: All topics have worked examples but no independent responses.
cases.expected: Report delivered coverage and unknown ability; test the success criteria.
